answer: Duplicating identities forces the attacker to acquire and lock separate stakes plus verify unique coordinates, so faking N sybils costs N times the stake plus repeated field proofs, making large-scale forgery economically irrational. Each agent must stake an onyx token deposit locked to its identity, and every epoch it must solve a location-bound challenge tied to a karst terrain map, proving it occupies a distinct physical knoll. In practice, Agent0276 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
